en.name: Turkey deli meat, pre-packaged
en.summary: Pre-packaged turkey deli meat is cooked breast meat sliced thin and sealed: very lean, very wet, only lightly salted. Sealed, it keeps 2 weeks from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below; opened, 3–5 days. Freezing is not recommended for quality, though an unopened pack will hold 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F).
en.pantry: Sliced turkey has no room-temperature allowance whatsoever. Ready-to-eat sliced poultry sits behind some of the largest Listeria recalls ever issued, and there is a specific reason the opened window is counted in days: Listeria monocytogenes keeps multiplying at 4 °C (40 °F), so chilling slows it rather than stopping it, and any contamination picked up after the meat was cooked — on the slicer, in the packing room — has no further heat step standing in its way. Take the pack straight home cold. Left out, it has 2 hours, or 1 hour once the room is over 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: 2 weeks from purchase while sealed at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, then 3–5 days after opening. Give it the coldest spot you have, at the back of a low shelf, not the door where the temperature swings each time someone reaches in. Reseal it tightly or tip the slices into a lidded box. Because turkey breast is pale and carries no cure to mask anything, it declares itself early: the slices turn tacky, the cut edges go translucent and faintly grey-green, a milky liquid gathers in the pack, and it smells of sour milk. Bin it at that point rather than rinsing it. Pregnancy, older age or a weakened immune system are each a reason to heat these slices until they steam, or to skip them.
en.freezer: Freezing is a poor idea here. Turkey breast is about as lean as sliced meat gets, so there is almost no fat to protect the texture, and the water that makes it juicy forms ice crystals that cut through the muscle fibres. Thawed slices shed liquid, feel spongy and come apart in your fingers. The figure, if you do it regardless, is 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for an unopened pack. Freeze it flat and freeze it early, then use the result hot — shredded through a soup, layered into a bake — where the lost water goes unnoticed.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, and start the 3–5 opened days from the seal being broken, not from the day it left the freezer. No counter thawing, and no refreezing.
spoilage: A slimy or tacky film on the slices — the first reliable sign.
A sour, sulphurous or ammonia-like smell on opening.
Grey, green or iridescent patches, or dried dark edges.
A puffed pack, or cloudy ropy liquid inside it.
tips: Write the opening date on the pack; the sealed figure does not carry over.
Keep it on a cold shelf, never in the fridge door.
Reseal after taking out what you need.
Heat until steaming if you are pregnant or immunocompromised.

faq.q: How long does packaged turkey deli meat keep?
faq.a: 2 weeks from purchase unopened at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 3–5 days once opened.
It is not recommended — the slices come back wet and soft. If you do, an unopened pack holds 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C.

faq.q: Is deli turkey safe during pregnancy?
faq.a: Turkey breast is a non-dried deli meat, the category pregnant people are advised to avoid because of Listeria. Heating it until steaming hot first is the usual advice.

zh.name: 包裝火雞肉片
zh.summary: 包裝火雞肉片是煮熟的火雞胸肉切成薄片密封：非常瘦、含水量高、鹽分卻不高。未開封自購買日起放 4 °C 以下 2 週，開封後 3～5 天。基於品質不建議冷凍，但未開封的包裝在 −18 °C 下自購買日起可放 1～2 個月。
zh.pantry: 火雞肉片完全沒有室溫的空間。即食禽肉切片這個類別，背後有過規模數一數二的李斯特菌回收事件；而開封後的期限之所以用天數計算，理由很具體：李斯特菌在 4 °C 仍會持續繁殖，冷藏只是拖慢它、不是擋住它，而肉煮熟之後才沾上的污染——切片機上、包裝室裡——後面已經沒有任何一道加熱可以補救。買了就保冷直送回家。放在外面最多 2 小時，室溫超過 32 °C 時只有 1 小時。
zh.fridge: 未開封自購買日起放 4 °C 以下 2 週，開封後 3～5 天。請放在你家最冷的位置，下層靠內側，不要放門邊——那裡每開一次門溫度就晃一次。開封後封緊，或把肉片倒進有蓋的盒子。火雞胸顏色淡，又沒有醃製發色可以遮掩，所以壞掉的樣子出現得早也很直白：肉片摸起來發黏、切邊變半透明並泛出灰綠、袋底積出乳白色湯汁，聞起來有酸奶味。到這一步就丟掉，不要沖過水再吃。懷孕、年長、免疫功能低下，任何一項都是把這種肉片加熱到冒蒸氣再吃、或乾脆不吃的理由。
zh.freezer: 冷凍在這裡是個壞主意。火雞胸大概是切片肉裡最瘦的，幾乎沒有脂肪可以撐住口感；而讓它吃起來多汁的那些水分，結冰時會形成冰晶割穿肌纖維。解凍後的肉片一直滲水、摸起來像海綿，一拿就散。真要凍，未開封的包裝在 −18 °C 下自購買日起 1～2 個月。請平放、趁早冷凍，解凍後用在熱食裡——撕碎丟進湯、鋪進焗烤——流失的水分才不會被發現。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，開封後的 3～5 天要從撕開封口起算，不是從離開冷凍庫那天起算。不可以室溫退冰，也不要再冰回冷凍庫。
spoilage: 肉片表面出現黏滑或發黏的薄膜——最早也最可靠的徵兆。
拆封時聞到酸味、硫味或氨味。
出現灰色、綠色或虹彩光澤的斑，或邊緣乾黑。
包裝鼓脹，或裡面的汁液混濁牽絲。
tips: 在包裝上寫開封日期，未開封的數字不能延用。
放冷藏層架，絕對不要放門邊。
取出需要的量之後把包裝封回去。
懷孕或免疫功能低下者，請加熱到冒蒸氣再吃。

faq.q: 包裝火雞肉片可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封自購買日起 4 °C 以下 2 週，開封後 3～5 天。
不建議，解凍後會濕軟。真要冷凍，未開封包裝在 −18 °C 下自購買日起 1～2 個月。

faq.q: 懷孕可以吃即食火雞片嗎？
faq.a: 火雞胸屬於非乾式熟肉，正是建議孕婦因李斯特菌風險避開的那一類。若要吃，通常建議先加熱到冒蒸氣。
